claim: Kuwait's airspace was closed from 28 February 2026 and reopened by the civil aviation authority on 23 April 2026
quote: reopened Kuwait’s airspace on April 23, 2026, ending a closure that had been in place since February 28, 2026

claim: Kuwait Airways and Jazeera Airways resumed direct flights from Kuwait International Airport on 26 April 2026
quote: Kuwait’s two national carriers resumed direct operations from Kuwait International Airport (KWI) on April 26, 2026

claim: On restart (late April 2026) Kuwait Airways planned Dhaka flights four times a week
quote: Jeddah and Dhaka would each be served four times per week

claim: During the closure Kuwait Airways and Jazeera flew from Al-Qaisumah and Dammam in Saudi Arabia, with passengers taken by road from Kuwait City, about four to five hours
quote: Kuwait Airways and Jazeera Airways operated from Al-Qaisumah (AQI) and King Fahd International Airport in Dammam (DMM), with passengers transported overland between Kuwait City and the Saudi airfields, a journey of roughly four to five hours by road

claim: Kuwait Airways announced Dhaka flights via Dammam twice a week from 24 April 2026
quote: The service, set to begin on April 24, 2026, will operate twice weekly.

claim: Passengers on the Dammam route crossed into Saudi Arabia by road through the Nuwaiseeb border crossing
quote: Passengers will be transported overland through the Nuwaiseeb border crossing before connecting to flights from Dammam.

claim: In early March 2026 Kuwait's airspace was closed but the land border with Saudi Arabia was open
quote: The embassy noted that Kuwaiti airspace remains closed, while the land border with the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia is currently open.

claim: MOI extended all types of visit entry visas that had expired or were about to expire by one month from 28 February 2026
quote: All types of visit entry visas that have expired or are about to expire during the current circumstances will be extended for one month starting Saturday, 28 February 2026.

claim: Residents outside Kuwait who had exceeded the permitted absence period and could not return got an additional three months, automatically and free of fees
quote: Expats who are currently outside Kuwait and have exceeded the permitted absence period, and are unable to return, will be granted an additional three months

claim: On 6 April 2026 an employer's representative (mandoub) was told by MOI that only expatriates with a valid residence and Civil ID could enter, not visit or first-time work visa holders, by land
quote: No Visit Visa holder or First time work visa Holder is Allowed to enter kuwait from any LAND border.

claim: From about 11 April 2026 Jazeera Airways accepted holders of a new Kuwait visit, family or work visa (valid over one month) to travel via Dammam, with a Saudi transit visa on arrival
quote: Passengers holding a passport valid for more than six (6) months, along with a Kuwait Visit, Family, or Work Visa (the visa must be valid for more than one month), are permitted to travel to Kuwait via Dammam.

claim: MOFA circular (April 2026): entry visas of all types (private-sector work, domestic work, joining a family sponsor) held by foreigners outside Kuwait who could not enter cannot be extended
quote: تعذّر تمديد صلاحية سمات الدخول بأنواعها، سواء «عمل أهلي» أو «عمل منزلي» أو «التحاق بعائل» للأجانب الحاصلين عليها وهم خارج البلاد

claim: MOFA circular (April 2026): the employer or applicant must apply for a new entry visa after the resumption of entry-visa issuing is announced (issuing was suspended at the time)
quote: يتعين على صاحب العمل أو العميل التقدم بطلب جديد لإصدار سمة دخول جديدة وفق الإجراءات والضوابط المعمول بها، بعد الإعلان عن استئناف إصدار سمات الدخول

claim: MOI's system gave residents abroad more than 6 months who could not return automatic 3-month absence permits from 28 February 2026, to stop their residence lapsing
quote: أذونات غياب آلياً لمدة 3 أشهر اعتباراً من 28 فبراير 2026، تفادياً لسقوط إقاماتهم

claim: PAM Decision 2/2026 let workers in small and medium enterprises, industry, agriculture, livestock and fishing transfer to another employer, with the original employer's approval, through Ashal
quote: transfer of visas for expatriate workers employed in specific sectors, namely small and medium enterprises, industry, agriculture, livestock, and fishing

claim: The PAM Decision 2/2026 transfer window ran from the beginning of May to the end of June 2026
quote: from the beginning of May until the end of June

claim: PAM said the transfer window was meant to use workers already in Kuwait rather than leave them idle
quote: The decision contributes to maximizing the utilization of the existing workforce in Kuwait, rather than allowing it to remain idle or underutilized.

claim: Kuwait International Airport began a phased resumption of operations on 26 April 2026
quote: Kuwait International Airport began a phased resumption of operations on April 26.

claim: As of 28 April 2026 the U.S. Embassy in Kuwait had temporarily suspended all consular services
quote: The U.S. Embassy Kuwait City has temporarily suspended all consular services.

claim: Article 18 workers must get an exit permit through the Sahel app, approved by the employer, before leaving Kuwait
quote: Expatriates on Article 17 (government) or Article 18 (private) visas in Kuwait must obtain an automated exit permit via the Sahel app before traveling out of Kuwait.

claim: An Iranian drone hit Kuwait International Airport's Terminal 1 early on 3 June 2026; air traffic was suspended and flights diverted
quote: Terminal 1 was hit by an Iranian drone in the early hours of Wednesday, 3 June, resulting in air traffic being suspended and flights diverted.

claim: Foreign airlines were to return to Kuwait from 17 June 2026 through Terminal 4, at first one flight a day each
quote: the flights will begin on Wednesday, 17 June, with the first phase allowing participating airlines to operate one flight per day

claim: Kuwait suspended issuing commercial visit visas for all nationalities on 10 June 2026
quote: June 10, 2026: Kuwaiti authorities have temporarily suspended the issuance of commercial visit visas for all nationalities until further notice.

claim: Kuwait resumed issuing commercial visit visas on 19 June 2026
quote: Kuwaiti authorities have resumed the issuance of commercial visit visas.

claim: Kuwait closed its airspace again on 18 July 2026 after renewed Iranian missile and drone attacks
quote: Kuwait closed its airspace on July 18, 2026, as renewed Iranian missile and drone attacks caused another round of disruption to civilian flights across the Persian Gulf.

claim: MOI: automatic extensions of entry visas and leave (absence) permits end and normal validity periods return from 1 September 2026
quote: Kuwait will discontinue automatic extensions granted to entry visas and leave permits and reinstate their legally prescribed validity periods effective September 1, 2026, the Ministry of Interior announced.

claim: Residents who left Kuwait on or before 31 August 2026 keep the additional exceptional absence extension
quote: However, expats who departed Kuwait on or before August 31, 2026, will continue to benefit from the additional exceptional extension, in accordance with the applicable regulations.

claim: The residence status certificate in the Sahel app is the official reference for when a resident's leave permit expires; residents abroad must return within that period
quote: The Ministry clarified that the residency permit status certificate issued through the Sahel app will be the official reference for determining the expiration date of a resident’s leave permit.

claim: Between February and July 2026 Kuwait's flight information region was closed and reopened several times during the Iran conflict
quote: Feb-Jul 2026: OKAC/Kuwait FIR was closed and reopened several times during the Iran conflict.

claim: Safe Airspace (late 2026): the threat from Iranian activity has eased but the wider risk of escalation remains
quote: Although the threat from Iranian activity has eased recently, the wider risk of escalation remains.

claim: BMET cleared 1,539 workers for Kuwait in March 2026
quote: 2026-03-01 to 2026-03-31: Kuwait total_employee 1539

claim: BMET cleared 2,036 workers for Kuwait in June 2026
quote: 2026-06-01 to 2026-06-30: Kuwait total_employee 2036
